tasks.spec: You are a bulk-backfill worker for jt-acculynx-mirror. GOAL: populate acculynx_backfill.job_representatives (sales-owner and company-rep assignments) for ALL non-archived jobs in public.acculynx_jobs (~6.5k), not just the 25-job pilot already present. BOUNDARY: READ-ONLY AccuLynx GET calls; INSERT/UPSERT only into acculynx_backfill.job_representatives; never call JobTread; one deliverable: /Users/chussey/Documents/a-roofers-open-brain/integrations/bridges/jobtread/mirror/reps-all/backfill-report.md; no credential values anywhere. CREDS: set -a; source /Users/chussey/.config/cleverwork/master.env; set +a. Supabase SQL: curl -s -X POST https://api.supabase.com/v1/projects/rnhmvcpsvtqjlffpsayu/database/query -H "Authorization: Bearer $SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"query":"<SQL>"}'. STRATEGY — CHEAP FIRST: (1) RAW EXTRACTION: the branches-salesreps mapping contract (/Users/chussey/Documents/a-roofers-open-brain/integrations/bridges/jobtread/mirror/branches-salesreps/mapping.md) found representative assignments embedded in public.acculynx_raw response envelopes. Inspect acculynx_raw payload shapes (payload_kind/endpoint columns), find rows carrying job representative data, and extract (job_id, rep_kind, user id, user_display_name) via SQL jsonb operations into job_representatives with source_endpoint='supabase:acculynx_raw:<kind>'. Join user ids to public.acculynx_users for display names when the envelope has only ids. (2) API GAP-FILL: for non-archived jobs still missing after extraction, call GET https://api.acculynx.com/api/v2/jobs/{jobId}/representatives (fall back to /representatives/company and /representatives/sales-owner) using PER-BRANCH KEY ROUTING by the job's account_key: colorado->PE_CC_COLORADO_ACCULYNX_API_KEY, florida->PE_CC_FLORIDA_ACCULYNX_API_KEY, georgia->PE_CC_GEORGIA_ACCULYNX_API_KEY, insurance_program->PE_CC_INSURANCE_PROGRAM_ACCULYNX_API_KEY, kansas_city->PE_CC_KANSAS_CITY_ACCULYNX_API_KEY, multi_family_commercial->PE_CC_MULTIFAMILY_COMMERCIAL_ACCULYNX_API_KEY, sandbox->PE_CC_SANDBOX_ACCULYNX_API_KEY, texas->PE_CC_TEXAS_ACCULYNX_API_KEY, wichita->PE_CC_WICHITA_ACCULYNX_API_KEY (verify names after sourcing; each key has its own 10 req/s limit — run up to 4 req/s PER KEY and you may interleave keys concurrently; on 429 back off with jitter). Write a python script for the sweep; batch UPSERTs 200+ rows per statement; idempotent ON CONFLICT; every row carries fetched_at + source_endpoint. Budget guidance: prefer covering ALL jobs; if a branch's key cannot see some jobs (404s), record the count per branch in ## Anomalies and move on. DELIVERABLE backfill-report.md sections: ## Raw Extraction (rows extracted, SQL used), ## API Gap-Fill (calls made per branch, coverage), ## Rows Loaded (before/after counts), ## Anomalies, ## Verdict. HARD RULES: honest coverage reporting; never fabricate assignments; a job with genuinely no representative is recorded as absent, not invented.
